title: The EP3-ZNF488 Axis Promotes Self-Renewal of Glioma Stem-Like Cells to Induce Resistance to Tumor Treating Fields.
authors: Chen, Dongjiang; Le, Son B; Manektalia, Harshit; Liu, Tianyi; Hutchinson, Tarun E; O'Dell, Adam; Salhia, Bodour; Tran, David D
one_liner_zh: 该文用基因网络机器学习算法发现EP3-ZNF488轴促进胶质瘤干细胞自我更新并介导TTFields耐药，虽涉及转录因子ZNF488与蛋白互作，但核心是肿瘤耐药机制而非TF-DNA结合建模，方法仅浅层机器学习，无AI/物理模拟的互作机制研究。
abstract: Tumor treating fields (TTFields) use low-intensity, alternating electric fields to exert antitumor activity and have demonstrated efficacy against multiple cancers, including glioblastoma (GBM). Unfortunately, cancer cells inevitably develop resistance to TTFields, highlighting the need to elucidate the underlying mechanisms to develop approaches to induce durable responses. Using a gene network-based machine learning algorithm, we interrogated TTFields-resistant GBM cells and uncovered a regulatory axis anchored by the prostaglandin E2 receptor 3 (EP3) and the transcription factor zinc finger 488 (ZNF488). Mechanistically, TTFields induced EP3 upregulation and nuclear envelope localization, where it formed a complex with ZNF488 to induce resistance to TTFields by promoting self-renewal of glioma stem-like cells (GSC). Overexpression of EP3 and/or ZNF488 in TTFields-sensitive GSC conferred resistance and enhanced self-renewal, whereas expression of noninteracting mutants of these proteins abrogated the formation of the nuclear complex and prevented resistance. Inhibition of either partner in this protein complex in resistant GSC, including those freshly isolated from TTFields-resistant GBM tumors, resensitized cells to the cytotoxic effects of TTFields, concomitant with reduced self-renewal and in vivo tumorigenicity. Importantly, inhibition of EP3 in TTFields-sensitive GSC preemptively halted the development of resistance. The EP3-ZNF488 axis was significantly upregulated in TTFields-resistant GBM tumors, and coexpression of EP3 and ZNF488 in other cancers correlated with lower survival rates. Collectively, these results indicate that the nuclear EP3-ZNF488 axis is necessary and sufficient to establish TTFields resistance, underscoring the potential to target this axis to prevent or reverse resistance in GBM and possibly other cancers. Significance: The EP3-ZNF488 master regulatory axis in cancer stem-like cells drives resistance to treatments like tumor treating fields, opening avenues for developing strategies to enhance therapeutic efficacy.
abstract_zh: 肿瘤治疗电场（TTFields）利用低强度、交替电场发挥抗肿瘤活性，并已显示出对多种癌症（包括胶质母细胞瘤（GBM））的疗效。不幸的是，癌细胞不可避免地会对TTFields产生耐药性，这凸显了阐明其潜在机制以开发诱导持久反应方法的必要性。利用基于基因网络的机器学习算法，我们研究了TTFields耐药的GBM细胞，并揭示了一个由前列腺素E2受体3（EP3）和转录因子锌指蛋白488（ZNF488）锚定的调控轴。机制上，TTFields诱导EP3上调和核膜定位，在此处EP3与ZNF488形成复合物，通过促进胶质瘤干细胞样细胞（GSC）的自我更新来诱导对TTFields的耐药性。在TTFields敏感的GSC中过表达EP3和/或ZNF488可赋予耐药性并增强自我更新，而表达这些蛋白的非相互作用突变体则消除了核复合物的形成并阻止了耐药性。在耐药GSC中（包括从TTFields耐药GBM肿瘤中新分离的细胞）抑制该蛋白复合物中的任一伙伴，可使细胞重新对TTFields的细胞毒性效应敏感，同时伴随自我更新和体内致瘤性降低。重要的是，在TTFields敏感的GSC中抑制EP3可先发制人地阻止耐药性的发展。EP3-ZNF488轴在TTFields耐药的GBM肿瘤中显著上调，且EP3和ZNF488在其他癌症中的共表达与较低的生存率相关。总体而言，这些结果表明核EP3-ZNF488轴对于建立TTFields耐药性是必要且充分的，强调了靶向该轴以预防或逆转GBM及其他可能癌症耐药性的潜力。意义：癌症干细胞样细胞中的EP3-ZNF488主调控轴驱动对肿瘤治疗电场等治疗的耐药性，为制定增强治疗效果的策略开辟了途径。
